mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_event (tenant_id, device_id, device_code, event_type, payload, run_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceCode}, #{eventType}, COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(#{payloadJson}, '') AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), #{runId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM device_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
